original18_findings_verbatim.finding: Pinned factory constructs Pillager; its registered ranged goal3 uses speed1/radius8, actual ranged method delegates to CrossbowAttackMob and shooting delegates its target-aware helper. Whole Pillager source provides local provenance, not current loaded Jar/natural spawn or a new patrol/raid reference.

Goal owns MOVE+LOOK and requests every-tick dispatch. Admission needs current alive target and a held CrossbowItem; continuation also includes canUse OR unfinished navigation but still requires valid target and held crossbow. No immutable victim, hand or ItemStack is captured in fields. Parent AI/priority/listener authority remains bounded.

Each delivered tick reads current target, computes signed seeTime from current LOS and requests chase only under (out-of-radius OR seeTime<5) AND attackDelay==0; otherwise stops navigation. UNCHARGED enters CHARGING after startUsingItem without checking that use actually started, then publishes charging flag. Source predicates do not establish arbitrary field combinations naturally reachable.

startUsingItem can return without starting for empty item/alreadyusing or hook duration below ForgeConfig minimum. Start is cancelable and duration mutable; Tick also mutable/cancelable. Goal still sets its local CHARGING after normal return. No current subscriber/config/default-duration execution has been verified.

CHARGING first changes local state to UNCHARGED if no longer using, but does not immediately return. It reads current use ticks/stack and, when threshold reached, calls void releaseUsingItem then unconditionally advances local state CHARGED and delay20..39, clearing charging flag on normal return. It does not inspect Charged NBT, loaded projectiles or load success.

Cancelable Stop suppresses ItemStack.releaseUsing callback when canceled; release still runs useOnRelease/update and stopUsing on normal flow. Thus a normally returning release request need not execute the crossbow loader. Exceptions/reentrant item hooks remain external, so neither guaranteed cancellation scenario nor atomic cleanup is claimed.

Goal.stop requests aggression false/target null and clears seeTime. Only if currently using does it stopUsing, clear charging flag, then setCharged(getUseItem(),false). Ordinary base stopUsing has already replaced useItem with EMPTY, so that subsequent getter is not the prior held crossbow object. No final global EMPTY-tag consequence, natural inventory loss or repair need is inferred.

No own start override resets the stage. stop does not reset crossbowState, attackDelay or updatePathDelay, and only conditionally clears charging flag. Same goal object reentry may retain CHARGED/READY state/delay while item use is separately stopped; goal reconstruction and full save/load are different unproven lifetimes.

CHARGED decrements its own delay to0 then READY. READY plus current LOS calls ranged attack with current target, reselects current crossbow hand to clear Charged, then becomes UNCHARGED. Interface reselects current hand again and calls shooting if a crossbow is currently held, but onCrossbowAttackPerformed runs after that condition even without an actual shot; Pillager resets noActionTime. No projectile-admission result is returned to goal.

Hand selection prefers main if predicate matches, otherwise off. Actual projectile shot obtains CrossbowAttackMob.getTarget again; Pillager performRangedAttack does not preserve its supplied target parameter as immutable victim. Current target/weapon can therefore differ across separate callbacks without a stored lease. No actual retarget exploit or callback race is reproduced.

Monster uses supported held projectile or freshly constructed ARROW fallback, then mutable noncancelable/no-result GetProjectile event. A living mob fallback arrow is not evidence of player-paid ammunition. Full ProjectileWeaponItem held-ammo chooser and all subscribers remain outside this batch.

Item release only marks Charged and requests loading-end sound when power>=1, !isCharged and tryLoadProjectiles true. It serializes charged projectile stacks, splitting first noncreative/nonduplicate ammo and copying remaining multishot entries. Item Charged flag, list payload and AI stage are independent; tryLoad mayfalse after earlier writes and has no shown rollback. Native item custody belongs to selected prior magazine owners as shared support0, not new migration credit.

performShooting reads payload list and handles nonempty indices0..2; server projectile path constructs, uses current target, applies durability before unchecked addFreshEntity and sound. onCrossbowShot clears projectile payload on normal return, including empty list case. Goal then separately clears Charged/current stage. A false entity add does not itself refund durability or preserve payload; exceptions can interrupt. No paid/captured actor or positive HP/actual shot receipt.
